_about: Every sentence the app itself says or shows to the worker, in English and Hindi. 'mwr' (Marwari) is optional: { text, reviewed_by, reviewed_on }. It is used only when all three are present and its {placeholders} match the Hindi; otherwise the Hindi text is shown and spoken. Marwari is filled from marwari-todo.json by scripts/apply-marwari.ts, never by hand here.

agent.question.worker_name.where: Visit agent, when the worker's name is missing (lib/agent.ts)

agent.question.household_id.where: Visit agent, when the household ID is missing (lib/agent.ts)

agent.question.health_findings.where: Visit agent, when no symptom or vital was recorded (lib/agent.ts)
agent.question.health_findings.en: Did you record a temperature or any symptoms?
agent.question.health_findings.hi: क्या आपने तापमान या कोई लक्षण नोट किया?

agent.question.follow_up_date.where: Visit agent, when the follow-up date is missing (lib/agent.ts)
agent.question.follow_up_date.en: When is the next follow-up visit?

agent.summary.where: Visit agent, read back once the visit is complete (lib/agent.ts). {who} is the patient or household, {noted} the findings, {date} the follow-up date.

agent.model_busy.where: Visit agent, when the language model was unavailable (app/api/extract/route.ts)
agent.model_busy.en: The language model is busy, so only the simple reader was used. If something you said is missing, please say it again.
agent.model_busy.hi: भाषा मॉडल अभी व्यस्त है, इसलिए सिर्फ़ साधारण तरीके से पढ़ा गया। अगर आपकी कोई बात छूट गई हो, तो कृपया दोबारा बोलिए।

visit.due.overdue.where: Start of a visit, when something is overdue (lib/schedule.ts). {labels} is the list of vaccines or checkups.
visit.due.overdue.hi: {name} के लिए {labels} बाकी है, {days} दिन से pending.

visit.due.today.where: Start of a visit, when something is due today (lib/schedule.ts)

protocol.maternal_anc.gestational_month.en: Which month of pregnancy is she in?
protocol.maternal_anc.gestational_month.hi: गर्भ का कौन-सा महीना चल रहा है?

protocol.maternal_anc.ifa_tablets_taken.en: Is she taking her IFA tablets?
protocol.maternal_anc.ifa_tablets_taken.hi: क्या वे IFA की गोली ले रही हैं?

protocol.maternal_anc.danger_signs.en: Any danger signs, such as bleeding or swelling?
protocol.maternal_anc.danger_signs.hi: कोई ख़तरे का लक्षण, जैसे खून आना या सूजन?

protocol.maternal_anc.expected_delivery_.en: What is the expected delivery date?
protocol.maternal_anc.expected_delivery_.hi: डिलीवरी की संभावित तारीख़ क्या है?

protocol.child_immunization.date_of_birt.en: What is the child's date of birth or age?
protocol.child_immunization.date_of_birt.hi: बच्चे की जन्म तारीख़ या उम्र क्या है?

protocol.child_immunization.growth_conce.hi: बढ़त या पोषण की कोई चिंता?

triage.age_question.where: Sick-child assessment, asking the child's age (app/api/triage/route.ts)
triage.age_question.en: How old is the child, in months?

triage.age_line.where: Sick-child assessment, before the first question when the age came from her sentence. {months} is a number.
triage.age_line.en: Taking the child's age as {months} months, from what you said. If that is wrong, say "age is wrong".
triage.age_line.hi: आपकी बात से बच्चे की उम्र {months} महीने ली है। गलत हो तो कहिए "उम्र गलत है"।

triage.age_unclear.where: Sick-child assessment, when the age was unclear. {reason} is a short English reason, {question} the age question.
triage.age_unclear.en: I could not be sure of the age ({reason}). {question}

triage.again.where: Sick-child assessment, after "galat hai" reopens the last question. {question} is that question.

triage.unclear.where: Sick-child assessment, when the answer was not understood. {question} is the question, {options} the choices.
triage.unclear.en: Sorry, I did not get that. {question}{options}

triage.outcome.not_applicable.hi: यह जाँच इस बच्चे पर लागू नहीं होती।

triage.out_of_range.where: Sick-child assessment not started because of the age (lib/imnci/flow.ts). {months} is a number.
triage.out_of_range.en: The child is {months} months old. This IMNCI assessment is only for children from 2 months up to 5 years, so it was not started.
triage.out_of_range.hi: बच्चा {months} महीने का है। यह IMNCI जाँच सिर्फ़ 2 महीने से 5 साल तक के बच्चों के लिए है, इसलिए शुरू नहीं की गई।

triage.out_of_range.young_infant.where: Added after triage.out_of_range for a baby under 2 months
triage.out_of_range.young_infant.en: For a young infant under 2 months, use the young infant chart; this app does not cover it.
triage.out_of_range.young_infant.hi: 2 महीने से छोटे शिशु के लिए young infant chart देखिए, यह app उसे नहीं करता।

triage.prompt.count.where: Sick-child assessment, wraps a counted measurement. {text} is the question.

triage.prompt.look.where: Sick-child assessment, wraps a sign she looks for. {text} is the observation.

triage.model_busy_start.where: Sick-child assessment, first question when the language model was down
triage.model_busy_start.en: The language model is busy, so I will ask each question in turn.
triage.model_busy_start.hi: भाषा मॉडल अभी व्यस्त है, इसलिए मैं हर सवाल एक-एक करके पूछूँगी।

triage.model_busy_repeat.yesno.where: Sick-child assessment, model down, asking a yes/no question again. {question} is the question.
triage.model_busy_repeat.yesno.en: The language model is busy, so I could not read that answer. Please say it again and answer "yes" or "no". {question}
triage.model_busy_repeat.yesno.hi: भाषा मॉडल अभी व्यस्त है, इसलिए जवाब समझ नहीं आया। कृपया दोबारा, "हाँ" या "नहीं" में जवाब दीजिए। {question}

triage.model_busy_repeat.days.where: Sick-child assessment, model down, asking a number of days again. {question} is the question.
triage.model_busy_repeat.days.en: The language model is busy, so I could not read that answer. Please say it again and say the number of days, for example "3 days". {question}
triage.model_busy_repeat.days.hi: भाषा मॉडल अभी व्यस्त है, इसलिए जवाब समझ नहीं आया। कृपया दोबारा, दिनों की संख्या बताइए, जैसे "3 दिन"। {question}

triage.group.skin_pinch.where: Sick-child assessment question written by the app (skin pinch, booklet page 10)
triage.group.skin_pinch.en: Pinch the skin of the abdomen and let go. Does it go back very slowly (longer than 2 seconds), slowly, or immediately?
triage.group.skin_pinch.hi: पेट की त्वचा चुटकी से पकड़कर छोड़िए। क्या वह बहुत धीरे (2 सेकंड से ज़्यादा में), धीरे, या तुरंत वापस जाती है?

triage.group.offer_fluid.where: Sick-child assessment question written by the app (offer fluid, booklet page 10)
triage.group.offer_fluid.en: Offer the child fluid. Is the child not able to drink or drinking poorly, drinking eagerly and thirsty, or drinking normally?
triage.group.offer_fluid.hi: बच्चे को पीने को दीजिए। क्या वह पी नहीं पा रहा या बहुत कम पी रहा है, प्यास से जल्दी-जल्दी पी रहा है, या सामान्य पी रहा है?

ui.hint.correction.en: Speak naturally in Hindi, English, or both. Say “that’s wrong” to fix the last answer.
ui.hint.correction.hi: हिंदी, अंग्रेज़ी या दोनों में बोलिए। पिछला जवाब ठीक करने के लिए “गलत है” कहिए।

ui.triage.wrong_age.where: Sick-child card, next to the age
ui.triage.wrong_age.hi: उम्र गलत है? कहिए “उम्र गलत है”।

ui.mic.too_short.where: Record page, after a press shorter than 300 ms
ui.mic.too_short.en: Hold to talk: keep the button pressed while you speak.

ui.mic.tap_start.where: Record page, mic button in tap mode

ui.mic.tap_stop.where: Record page, mic button in tap mode while recording
ui.mic.tap_stop.hi: रिकॉर्ड हो रहा है… रोकने के लिए दबाइए
